# PSL - PHP Standard Library

> A standard library for PHP, inspired by hhvm/hsl: a consistent, centralized, well-typed set of APIs covering async, collections, networking, I/O, cryptography, terminal UI, and more, replacing PHP functions and primitives with safer, async-ready alternatives that error predictably.

Install everything with `composer require php-standard-library/php-standard-library`, or install any component as a standalone package. Each link below is the full markdown documentation for that component.
